text:
Jules A.: Tiny life update: we eloped in Maui last week (so much aloha) 48D, adopted a tiny frenchie named Mochi, and I accepted Principal Designer at Redwood (starts May). Low-key drop-in tomorrow 4pm in kitchen for a quick hello? No pressure.
Ravi: WHAT. All of it?? Huge congrats on the promotion and the pup!! :tada: I can bring a small chocolate cake.
Nora: Eloped?? Ring photo pls 60D Also congrats on Principal Designer 389 Mochi pics are mandatory.
Sam: Massive congrats!! I will be there for a quick toast. Can we set up a Zoom link for remote folks?
Talia: Bringing dog-safe treats for Mochi and a tiny banner. Color theme: ocean blues?
PeopleOpsBot: Congrats Jules! Promo effective May 4. HR will send the company announcement after manager confirmation. Please submit your new title badge request here: https://hr.redwood-internal/badges
OfficeBot: Kitchen reserved 16:00-16:30 tomorrow by Jules A. Fridge check reminder: label perishable items by 18:00 or they may be discarded.
Jules A.: Thank you all 970 Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (short call so remote folks can pop in). No gifts, but if anyone wants to chip in for a takeout New-York-style pup bowl for Mochi DM me.
Ravi: Song rec for 4pm playlist: "Island in the Sun". Also bringing plates/napkins.
Nora: I'll make a tiny slideshow of Maui + Mochi photos for the TV. Remote folks can drop pics in the shared drive.
Sam: Sending GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-dog-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA
Talia: I'll print a small "Congrats Jules & Mochi" sign and bring a plush squeaky toy. Mochi meetup? :dog2:
Jules A.: Love it. See you all tomorrow 60A Thanks for the love 495
